proof_search_source.local_acceptance: integrated as a separate disaster trace lifting module after local Lean build and placeholder scan

boundaries: Harness-only guarantees apply only to traces admitted by the harness.
Full concrete unreachability requires a concrete barrier or a forward simulation into an abstract barrier.
The certificate object packages proof obligations; it does not discover barriers or prove runtime harness completeness by itself.
Product-axis theorems exclude the disjunction of named component disasters under the stated sync or async product semantics.
claim: Bounded disaster witness certificates can be lifted into reusable unreachability claims when their harness, barrier, axis-exclusion, product-composition, or forward-simulation obligations are supplied. A witnessed disaster trace refutes the corresponding barrier certificate, and a concrete barrier or simulation barrier excludes named disasters over all reachable concrete states covered by the stated system model.
